chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Qurashi al-Razzaz narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Sa'id al-Qammad, from Umar ibn Yazid the seller of the Sabiriyyah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, the land of the Ka'bah said: 'Who is like me? And Allah has built His House upon my back, and people come to me from every deep passage, and I have been made the sanctuary and security of Allah.' So Allah revealed to her: 'Be silent and settle down. By My glory and majesty, the favor with which you were favored, in what I gave to the land of Karbala, is not except like the position of a needle that was planted in the sea, and it carried from the water of the sea. And if it were not for the soil of Karbala, I would not have favored you. And if it were not for what the land of Karbala contained, I would not have created you, nor would I have created the House in which you boast. So be silent and settle down, and be a humble, lowly, insignificant world, not arrogant nor haughty towards the land of Karbala. Otherwise, I will be displeased with you and cast you into the fire of Hell.'

And my father and Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ali, who said: 'Abbad Abu Sa'id al-Usfuri narrated to us from Umar ibn Yazid the seller of the Sabiriyyah, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him), and he mentioned the like of it.'
ai.seo_question: Why is the land of Karbala superior to the Ka'bah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarah* illustrates the Shia theological concept of the preeminence of Karbala, where the Ka'bah’s pride is humbled by divine revelation. It establishes that the martyrdom of Imam Husayn (a.s.) is the pivotal event that elevates Karbala above all other sacred spaces, rendering the Ka'bah’s status secondary in comparison to the 'soil' that holds this ultimate sacrifice.
